name: service-report
title: Service report
for_each: select id,code from jobs where status in ('done','invoiced') and completed_at>=now()-interval '30 days'

sections.title: Job
sections.sql: select j.code,j.kind,c.name as customer,s.name as site,j.reported_at,j.arrived_at,j.completed_at,t.name as technician from jobs j join customers c on c.id=j.customer_id left join sites s on s.id=j.site_id left join technicians t on t.id=j.technician_id where j.id=$1

sections.title: Unit
sections.sql: select e.code,e.serial,e.model,j.hour_meter as hours_at_visit,e.warranty_ends_on from jobs j join equipment e on e.id=j.equipment_id where j.id=$1

sections.title: Fault and work done
sections.sql: select description as reported,resolution as work_done,round(labour_minutes/60.0,2) as labour_hours,checklist_done from jobs where id=$1

sections.title: Parts fitted
sections.sql: select part_number,description,qty from parts_used where job_id=$1 order by code

name: contract-schedule
title: Service agreement schedule
for_each: select id,code from contracts where status='active'

sections.title: What it covers
sections.sql: select case when covers_labour then 'Yes' else 'No' end as labour,case when covers_parts then 'Yes' else 'No' end as parts,renewal_notice_days from contracts where id=$1

sections.title: Units covered
sections.sql: select e.code,e.serial,e.model,s.name as site from contract_equipment ce join equipment e on e.id=ce.equipment_id left join sites s on s.id=e.site_id where ce.contract_id=$1 order by e.code

sections.title: Planned maintenance schedule
sections.sql: select p.unit,p.task,p.interval_days,p.interval_hours,p.next_due_on from pm_due p join contract_equipment ce on ce.equipment_id=p.equipment_id where ce.contract_id=$1 order by p.unit

name: unit-history
title: Equipment service history
for_each: select id,code from equipment where status<>'removed'

sections.title: Service history
sections.sql: select j.code,j.kind,(j.completed_at at time zone 'UTC')::date as done_on,j.hour_meter,t.name as technician,j.resolution from jobs j left join technicians t on t.id=j.technician_id where j.equipment_id=$1 and j.status in ('done','invoiced') order by j.completed_at desc
